newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Tabaqueira selloff could be in early 97 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Tabaqueira selloff could be in early 97 - paper.

text.p: Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira dos Santos told a Lisbon newspaper that the privatisation of Portuguese tobacco company Tabaqueira could be delayed until next year, although he thought it unlikely.
Asked if the selloff of a 65 percent stake in Tabaqueira, Portugal's dominant cigarette manufacturer, could be delayed from this year to 1997, Teixeira dos Santos told Diario de Noticias newspaper:
"There is some risk that this could happen, but I think it is a limited risk. Very probably it will still be this year."

Last week Economy Minister Augusto Mateus referred the privatisation of Tabaqueira to the Competition Council, which has 30 days to give an opinion on the likely impact of the sale on the local market. Mateus will have a further 15 days to consider the bids.

The candidates to buy Tabaqueira are the U.S. group Philip Morris, in partnership with Portugal's Jorge de Mello group; state-owned Spanish tobacco company Tabacalera, allied to Madeira company Empresa Madeirense de Tabacos; and French group Seita.
